literal.prompt: В каком национальном парке находится знаменитый гейзер Олд-Фейтфул?

literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS directly identifies Old Faithful as a famous geyser in Yellowstone (L22-L28). Four choices are actual national parks; no text in the question announces a country that trivially gives the answer.
literalGroups.locator: NPS Old Faithful page L22-L28; other national park identities verified against their full official sources.

literalGroups.literal: Это Йеллоустонский национальный парк. Олд-Фейтфул — один из почти 500 гейзеров парка; рейнджеры сейчас прогнозируют извержения шести из них.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS says the geyser is one of nearly 500 in Yellowstone and one of six whose eruptions the park currently predicts (L26-L31).

literalGroups.literal: В Банфе находятся озёра Луиз и Морейн, популярные туристические места Канады.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Parks Canada places Lake Louise and Moraine Lake in Banff National Park and calls them among Canada’s most-visited destinations (L17-L22). It does not claim Canadian Rockies; that assertion was removed.

literalGroups.literal: Ледники придали выразительные формы гранитным массивам Торрес-дель-Пайне.
literalGroups.primaryGround: CONAF says the granite massif forms were modelled by glacial ice and that glacial advance/retreat shaped the imposing forms (L154-L155). Russian now attributes shaping to the forms, not the creation of the granite body.

literalGroups.literal: В Йеллоустоне сосредоточено около 60 процентов гейзеров мира.
literalGroups.primaryGround: NPS states Yellowstone contains close to 60% of the world’s geysers (L42). This adds a concrete fact about the correct park beyond the Old Faithful prompt/key.

literalGroups.literal: Основанный в 1914 году парк считается старейшим в Альпах.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Swiss National Park official page states its 1914 founding and that it is the oldest national park in the Alps (L7-L10,L20).
